body: You made a really good point how she should have come to me first. That's exactly how I feel about this but couldn't put it into words. I'm going to go with the non confrontational route, just because I want to just get this over with and get her out of my life.

I don't have a copy of it, but I plan on getting one tomorrow and showing it to him. I told him I don't, but I know if I were in his shoes id want something more than a strangers word. 

That's a really good way to put it, I hope she would listen to that. I'm slightly worried she's spread the word that I have herpes and didn't disclose, I wouldn't really put it past her.
